provenance_label: Live run on a local kind cluster

issue.symptom: Pods restart repeatedly with OOMKilled; new Pods never become Ready.

observations.text: New storefront Pod is OOMKilled while warming a 160 MiB cache; memory limit is 128Mi, but docs require cache + ~40 MiB (~200 MiB).
evidence: logs: warming product image cache: 160 MiB
docs/config.md: container needs cache_warm_mb plus about 40 MiB

agent_conclusion.root_cause: The storefront Deployment's memory limit (128Mi) was below the memory needed for the marketing-increased 160 MiB product image cache plus ~40 MiB of process overhead, so new Pods were OOMKilled during cache warm-up and the rollout could not finish.
agent_conclusion.summary: Raised the storefront container memory request to 200Mi and limit to 256Mi in k8s/deployment.yaml and applied it. The rollout completed with 2/2 Ready Pods, and health, readiness, and checkout HTTP checks through the Service succeed.
evidence: Pod storefront-954cd69d7-rr26w previous logs: warming product image cache: 160 MiB then OOMKilled
Deployment memory limit was 128Mi; docs/config.md requires cache_warm_mb plus ~40 MiB

attempted_changes.name: storefront
attempted_changes.reason: Increase memory resources to accommodate 160 MiB cache plus overhead.
